name: Skyrim Together Reborn
author: fossiltalk@users.noreply.github.com
description: Skyrim Together Reborn dedicated server, built on the official tiltedphoques/st-reborn-server image. Players need the same STR version as the server. UDP only (default 10578).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Server binaries ship in the yolk image; this only prepares the persistent folders.
set -e
cd /mnt/server
mkdir -p config Data logs
cat > Data/README.txt <<'TXT'
Skyrim Together Reborn - Data folder

Mod check (Panel > Startup > "Mod check") makes the server refuse players whose
mods don't match. When it is on, put your group's loadorder.txt here:

    Data/loadorder.txt

Get it from the host player's game: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Skyrim Special Edition\loadorder.txt
(or from Mod Organizer 2's profile folder). Everyone must use the same STR version,
mod list and load order.
TXT
chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Install done."

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players type to join. Also keeps the server off the public list. At least 8 characters.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Joining with this password gives admin rights. Panel admins only.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Player cap. Going over 8 isn't recommended upstream.

variables.name: Mod Check
variables.description: true = refuse players whose mods don't match Data/loadorder.txt.

variables.name: PvP
variables.description: true = players can damage each other.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: 0 Novice, 1 Apprentice, 2 Adept, 3 Expert, 4 Master, 5 Legendary.
